on Thursday, Tesla shared a new teaser for the upcoming Roadster, showcasing what appears to be an LED light bar at the front of the vehicle. “See you next week,” Tesla said in the post.
The teaser also featured the word ‘Roadster’ and the letter ‘X,’ although it is unclear whether the imagery is intended to reference
involvement in the vehicle’s development. Musk has previously said the Roadster could feature SpaceX-developed cold-gas thrusters.

children: used in SpaceX’s rockets for altitude control during the Falcon 9 rocket’s landings, with 10 thrusters expected to be placed where rear seats usually are, the report said.
The Tesla Semi official handle also took to X, sharing new information about the Semi. “Today, we’re launch high volume production,” the post said.

CEO Musk, in a video shared by the handle, said that the Semi will be a “revolutionary” truck and be like a “sports car in truck form.” Musk also said that the Semi will have access to the Tesla Megacharger network, offering Megawatt charging.

The CEO also said that the Semi will feature autonomous driving technology, with Tesla adding self-driving features in the “very near future.” Musk then said that the Truck made sense economically amid record-high diesel prices in the U.S.
Today, we're launching high volume production

In a separate post, the Semi handle shared that Tesla will target producing 50,000 units of the Semi annually at its 1.8 million square-foot facility. Tesla’s official website also says the truck requires lower maintenance than a traditional diesel-powered truck.

children: Elon Musk Touts Cybercab’s Local Nickel Cathode

On Wednesday, Musk hailed Tesla Cybercab’s locally sourced Nickel cathode for its battery built in Tesla’s Gigafactory in Texas. Musk has touted Tesla’s domestic manufacturing process, saying that the automaker’s EVs have the highest percentage of American made/sourced content when compared to all its rivals.
Tesla shares were up 0.38% to $379.32 during overnight trading on Thursday.
